content: Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. This information was last updated in July 2024. Important Usage Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete details about this product and your individual health needs. Overdose Instructions: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less severe cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Medical Monitoring: While using this medication, it is important to undergo regular laboratory and medical tests, such as viral load and T-cell counts, to monitor your health. Missed Dose Instructions: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Storage Guidelines: Store the medication in its original packaging at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Disposal Instructions: Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless directed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed. Additional Notes: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive further details and instructions on how to access the offer.
